'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is the very final [[Special Mission|Spotlight Mission]] of the game that ran from December 1st, 2022 ~ January 13th, 2023.

== Synopsis ==
''The time has come to leave this world, its many realities, its countless timelines, and seek adventure in the infinite multiverse. However, dark forces still look to claim what power remains and perhaps corrupt all worlds beyond. One final mission remains, as Optimus and the Commander initiate the EXODUS PROTOCOL.''

== Transcript ==
=== Chapter 1 - Farewell  ===
====Mission 1 - Last Chance ====
===== Part 1 =====

* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]Optimus Prime: Wheeljack, the time has come, I am giving permission to activate the EXODUS PROTOCOL.
* [[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: The Exodus Protocol means opening ALL the Space Bridges and more, every untested travel tool l've invented will be activated, that'll CERTAINLY destroy the planet.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Indeed, it is a last hope, but still a hope, Use the weapon of our foes against them, While it will scatter us all across realities we still may survive.
* [[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: I'm totally fine with this plan, just wanted to double check on the whole "blow it all up" part! I have prepared a giant button JUST for this occasion, I'll go push it,
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Blaster, get the word out. Abandon planet, take any transport you can find. Inform all Autobots, Decepticons, and independent operators alike.
* [[File:Blaster Icon.jpg|30x30px]] [[Blaster]]: What about JUST the Autobots? I may have time to round THEM up.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: This is bigger than any feuds, they all deserve a chance, EVERY, ONE.
* [[File:Blaster Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Confirmed, I'll get the word out. Let's hope folks are willing to listen!

===== Part 2 =====

* [[File:Megatron G1 Icon v2.jpg|30x30px]] [[Megatron]]: What right do you have to give orders to those under my command?
*[[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: I assumed you wished for them to survive the coming calamity, was I mistaken? The sun never sets on Cybertron so long as some of us survive.
*[[File:Megatron G1 Icon v2.jpg|30x30px]]: Those who are worth saving will find a way to continue to function, the rest can burn in the fires of New Quintessa.
*[[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: As always you are deeply charming, Mega-trash. Now move out of the way I have gates to open,
*[[File:Megatron G1 Icon v2.jpg|30x30px]]: I do not listen to lesser life forms such as you, I have found finer company to keep, Is that not right, my lieges?
* [[File:Megatronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]] [[Megatronus]]: Indeed, the multiverse still has treasures to find. Power to control, MUCH MORE TO GIVE,
* [[File:Necrotronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]] [[Necrotronus]]: We should have put aside our squabbles and joined forces LONG ago,
*[[File:Megatron G1 Icon v2.jpg|30x30px]]: Now then, hand over control of the Space Bridges OR BE DESTROYED!

====Mission 2 - Lights Off ====
===== Part 1 =====

* [[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Thanks for the assist, Commander, I flipped EVERYTHING on and there are bridges, lots of bridges, one could argue TOO MANY bridges.
* [[File:Jetfire Icon.jpg|30x30px]] [[Jetfire]]: Blaster's evacuation message was sent, everyone was VERY eager to not explode. Wheeljack, what you're doing here is TRIULY astonishing in its apocalyptic scale,
* [[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Awww thanks bud, appreciate you too!
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Good work, once everyone jumps through slam the bridges closed behind them,
* [[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Luckily everything is overloading and exploding so that's going to pretty much happen naturally, but I'll speed it along.
* [[File:Megatronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Fools! What are you doing?! We'll all be doomed!
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: No, not all of us, just you and your power hungry compatriots, The rest shall find refuge in the infinite realities of the multiverse.
* [[File:Megatronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Then I shall enjoy hunting each and every traitor who dared to deny me of a kingdom to rule.

==== Part 2 ====

* [[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Jetfire and I are making the jump, you'll be right behind us right Optimus?
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: I'll see you on the other side, Wheeljack.
* [[File:Wheeljack Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Weird way to phrase it but alright! It's been a trip! Jetfire wait up! I made a travel playlist!
* [[File:Necrotronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: You have bought them seconds, this planet contains an undead titan and astounding power. We shall use both to destroy you,
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: The Space Bridges have destabilized this world and drained ALL the power within it, soon you'll be ruling nothing but dust.
* [[File:Megatronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: You wouldn't dare do that much damage to the timelines. You're bluffing. We will always find a way to succeed.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Perhaps in some strange universe you will. But in this world, in this reality, you have gone this far, and no further.
* [[File:Megatronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Then I have nothing left to lose, and shall make the most of this chance to destroy ONE LAST PRIME!

====Mission 3 - Roll Out ====
===== Part 1 =====

* [[File:Necrotronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: So it has come to this... a single Autobot, their weak human, and certain doom.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Marissa, is everyone off world?
* [[File:Marissa Faireborn.png|30x30px]] [[Marissa Faireborn]]: As far as I can tell It's just us, the Commander, and a trio of 'Tronuses left here.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: The rest will need guidance and communications, get out of here while you can, Marissa.
* [[File:Marissa Faireborn.png|30x30px]]: Prime I can't just leave you both behind, You'll be trapped as the realities collapse when the bridges close!
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Someone needs to ensure we have stopped the plague of Necrotronus from escaping. Leave NOW! That is an order!
* [[File:Necrotronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Don't worry, you'll all be joining up soon in OBLIVION!
* [[File:Marissa Faireborn.png|30x30px]]: Optimus, it has been an honor, Commander, knock 'Tronus out for me, This is Officer Marissa Faireborn, signing off of coms on New Quintessa.

===== Part 2 =====

* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Hold the line, we just need to give the others enough time to get away and this will all be over.
* [[File:Nercotronus featured B.png|30x30px]]'''WE SHALL NEVER END! OUR FURY WILL ECHO THROUGH THE AGES!'''
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Commander, without question THIS is our darkest hour, but you have always been a light to those who found their way here.
* [[File:Necrotronus Icon.jpg|30x30px]]: Words, words, words. Spare us the monologue, We have heard enough.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: Ignore them, Commander. You were forged to fight and have proven yourself again and again. If this is our last fight then... I thank you.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: I thank you for your time, your support, your passion, your friendship. Though your squad was often a curious mix of teams, know that you are forever a TRUE Autobot.
* [[File:Nercotronus featured B.png|30x30px]] '''ENOUGH! ATTACK US, PRIME! ACCEPT YOUR FATE!'''
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: It is a strange time for field promotions, but you have more than earned it. I proudly dub you: COMMANDER PRIME, PROTECTOR OF CYBERTRON.
* [[File:Optimus Prime Icon v3.jpg|30x30px]]: I look forward to the day where all are one with the Matrix, and we meet again my friend. But for now... ROLL OUT!
